text: Scrape a web page's HTML with a single API call using just an API key and target URL
quote: To scrape a web page, you only need two things: Your API key... The encoded web page URL you want to scrape

text: Render JavaScript-heavy single-page apps (React, Angular, jQuery, Vue) and return rendered HTML
quote: This can be useful for scraping a Single Page Application built with frameworks such as React.js, Angular.js, JQuery or Vue.

text: Script page interactions like clicks and form fills via a JavaScript scenario before HTML is returned
quote: If you want to interact with pages you want to scrape before we return your the HTML you can add JavaScript scenario to your API call.

text: Wait for a specific CSS/XPath selector to appear before returning rendered HTML
quote: Our headless browsers will wait for the CSS / Xpath selector passed in the parameter before returning the HTML.

text: Block ads on the target page to speed up scraping requests
quote: By default, ScrapingBee does not block ads. To avoid scraping them (e.g.,to speed up your request), use `block_ads=true`

text: Blocks images and CSS by default to reduce bandwidth, with option to disable
quote: By default, and to speed up requests, ScrapingBee blocks all images and CSS in the scraped page, but to scrape them, use `block_resources=false`

text: Control the browser viewport width and height when rendering the target page
quote: If you need to change the dimension of the browser's viewport (window) when scraping the target page you can use the `window_width` and `window_height` parameters.

text: Extract structured data from a page using CSS selector-based extraction rules
quote: extract_rules [stringified JSON] ("") Data extraction from CSS selectors

text: Extract information from a webpage using an AI query instead of selectors
quote: ai_query [string] ("") The information you want to extract from the webpage using AI

text: Use premium proxies to bypass websites that are difficult to scrape
quote: premium_proxy [boolean] (false) Use premium proxies to bypass difficult to scrape websites

text: Request a premium proxy from a specific country/geolocation
Route multiple API requests through the same IP address using a session ID
quote: session_id [integer] ("") Route multiple API requests through the same IP address

text: Capture a screenshot of a specific page area targeted by a CSS selector
quote: screenshot_selector [string] ("") Return a screenshot of a particular area of the page, targeted by a CSS selector

text: Automatically pick the cheapest configuration that still succeeds via an 'auto' mode
quote: mode [string] ("") Let ScrapingBee pick the cheapest configuration that succeeds. Only value is auto

text: Return the scraped page content in markdown format
quote: return_page_markdown [boolean] (false) Return the page content in markdown format
